title: Photodynamic regulation of potato greening: sodium copper chlorophyllin-functionalized alginate/sanxan nanocomposite films with spectral-selective barrier properties
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00470E, Paper

Erihemu, Chuchu Zhang, Hongze Lv, Ke Shi, Jing Wang, Fan Yang, Yi Wu, Hui Ma, Pengfei Zhang, Wenliang Qi
An innovative sodium alginate/sanxan (SA/SAN) composite film incorporating sodium copper chlorophyllin (SCC) was used to control postharvest potato tuber greening.
